summary: Pasqal Holding SA, a French neutral-atom quantum computing company now listed on Nasdaq following its de-SPAC combination, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 6, 2026, covering third quarter 2026 results. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. Reported figures include quarterly revenue of 3.3 million (versus 5.7 million a year earlier), QPU-related services revenue of 3.1 million, government grant income of 1.0 million, booked and awarded business of 69.8 million, and cash of 312.8 million. Items are ordinary operating and technology updates, not a special situation; watch commercialization execution and cash burn.
